reviewerRole: Independent semantic and identity review; not author, not final cross-unit acceptance.
scope: Whole-object review of all 18 exact frozen OOD-N07-B08 proposal objects, including prompt, constraints, options, answer.optionId, Reason, all five Details fields and every wrong-option diagnostic; compared to actual current source objects and relevant accepted controls.
summary: The question set covers several distinct persistence failure boundaries and most case-local alternatives/diagnostics align. Yet all 18 second constraints give the keyed policy and Reasons repeat it. Additional concrete issues: i006 conflicts on whether the remote referral was accepted, i017 assumes provider lookup/idempotency by a local notice ID without stating support, and i001/i009/i018 repeat the durable same-ID replay decision. Those overlaps merit distinct recovery boundaries or justified practice design, not a blanket ban on repetition.

cohortFindings.finding: For every item, constraints[1] states the keyed mechanism/selection. The canonical guidelines require constraints to provide scenario facts rather than disclose the answer.

Every Reason’s second sentence repeats the same implementation prescription; every Details.scenarioApplication repeats it as well. This does not add the causal reasoning requested by the BIZQ Reason/Details contract.

Raw character-count scan shows B06 17/18, B07 13/18 and B08 13/18 uniquely longest keyed choices. This is supporting evidence of a repeated full-policy-key shape, not a numeric threshold or equal-length requirement.

All original question IDs are retained while the answer-option IDs change from the source’s generic owner_preserves_contract to new case-specific IDs. The retained mental-unit decision is generally plausible; author notes should explicitly justify the old-to-current primary meaning per item rather than rely on unit membership alone.

limitations: This report reviews only the exact frozen proposal inputs named above.
No source activation, producer validation, consumer integration, admission, runtime, native, Premium, or full BIZQ-01 acceptance is claimed.
Where general technical references are listed, they support only general language/mechanism claims, not fictional case guarantees.

items.beforePrompt: In a marketplace payout service, the finance operator must release a seller payout. Release is idempotent and tied to a settled order. The interview lens is “Persistence failures, idempotency, retries, and consistency boundaries”: apply it without relying on a pattern name. The design review now adds a second workflow variant. This is a simplicity check: which decision best preserves the contract?
items.beforeAcceptedOptionText: Make retry and consistency behavior explicit at the infrastructure boundary and keep domain state truthful. In this case, that keeps the rule “release is idempotent and tied to a settled order” inside the owner that can observe and enforce it.
items.currentPrompt: In photo-archive curation tool, An import job receives the same provider batch twice. Each row has a stable provider asset key; an already imported key should update descriptive metadata without creating a second asset identity. What should the persistence workflow do?

optionSetReviewed.text: Create a new archive asset for every batch delivery and deduplicate titles afterward.
optionSetReviewed.targetFeedback: Titles can collide and do not identify the provider asset.

optionSetReviewed.text: Use the row position as identity because batches retain the same order during one run.
optionSetReviewed.targetFeedback: Row order is not the stated stable identity.

optionSetReviewed.text: Reject the entire batch when any provider key already exists.
optionSetReviewed.targetFeedback: An existing key means a repeat can be handled, not necessarily that the entire batch is invalid.

optionSetReviewed.text: Deduplicate by title and leave the first imported row unchanged even when the stable asset key matches.
optionSetReviewed.targetFeedback: The contract allows metadata updates to the same asset identified by its provider key.

optionSetReviewed.text: Upsert by the stable provider asset key and preserve the existing archive asset identity on repeat import.
